quotes.text: D323259's same-folder guard suppresses `dstFolder.updateFolder(null)` only when every cached source header already belongs to the destination. Attachment replacement copies the modified message, updates the tracker through `attachment-delete-msgkey-changed`, deletes the original, and has its own awaited IMAP refresh; the observed later `msgKeyChanged` is a no-op. Cross-folder IMAP operations keep refresh-and-await behavior. Independent exact rechecks passed the paired build, the attachment browser test 48/0 normally and with `--enable-a11y-checks`, and `test_ext_messages_id.js` 3/0. [Task 3]
